scope.frame: B1656's four-channel coupling at B1667's canonical end
scope.object: the coupling's determinant, B1701's line-tied spectrum, the first generation's exact zeros
scope.hypotheses: the converse at generic tau (off Re tau = 0); the identities unclipped; R_p* = 0 numerical

claim_one_line: THE FRAME'S EXACT ZEROS, DERIVED (P-262, P-268; no data; scoped by the referee's audit, RETRACTIONS row 44): det(sum u_s E_s*) = 1/4 sum u_s^2 and the residue matrix has rank one for every twist, so det M = 1/4 sum c_s R_s^2, independent of L when no channel is clipped (min 2 pi L + c_s = 1.24 on the grids); the coupling is Y_ab = sum m_s [C_a^-1 S C_b]_s, so with S = C_p and m_p = 0 it is a signed cross product with spectrum (|w|, |w|, 0), and B1701's 0 : 1 : 1 follows given R_p* = 0 on the 27 tied lines (numerical); a left twist of exact order 4 with a right twist of order <= 2 cancels D (the involution u -> -u pairs the channels with lambda = +-i; proved, Z6 confirming) -- the law that predicted B1713's order-4 lines before they were read; at generic tau no other line-sector of order 1-12 vanishes, while on Re tau = 0 the up and down quarks also vanish on the 16 order-12 lines with 12 alpha odd (P-292, unexplained). 0 of 19.
weave_or_thread: weave (every charged sector on one fibre; every line of order <= 12)
